question: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. P has an exam on Thursday. T has an exam immediately before P, and V has an exam immediately after P. Only 3 people have an exam between U and Q. R has an exam immediately after Q. How many people have an exam between Q and S?
solution:
Given: Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) P has an exam on Thursday.
